positions.name: XRP (Ripple)

XRP funds were the bright spot in crypto ETF flows while BTC/ETH funds bled, and XRP/BTC is +2.7% on the week (XRP +9% off the $1.009 weekly low).
positions.driver: Best asymmetric setup on the tape: a named fresh catalyst (EU license), demonstrated relative strength vs BTC during the recovery, and a clean invalidation level — stop set below both the $1.009 weekly low and the psychological $1.00. BTC (runner-up) has the ETF inflow snap-back (+$221.7M, largest in 2 months) but is capped under the $64-65k resistance zone; SOL's +14% week is undercut by -29% volume; ETH still shows net ETF outflows; HYPE isn't Robinhood spot. Entry = dashboard live feed (asOf 2026-07-07T11:52:39Z).
